format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header written by a converter ('Converted Saves' / 'Converted Save' / 'Conversion code by UniqueGeeks.Net'), then 512 KiB raw for the 512 KiB flash (exact size)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 524288 --stem 'Pokemon - Pearl Version (USA) (Rev 5)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; fits it to the 524288-byte chip (exact size) and writes each core's file
